# Auto-Update Check

Run BEFORE any execution (all modes). Silent if current. One prompt max if update exists.

Distribution uses the public GitHub primary at `https://github.com/h3tech-ai/marketplace` plus a release-synchronized legacy mirror at `https://synaptory.h3t.co/marketplace.git` for existing Claude installations (ADR-027). The CLI version pin lives at `https://synaptory.h3t.co/cli/latest.json`. The source repo (`h3tech-ai/synaptory`) stays private; only the IP-stripped catalog is published.

**Step 0 — version check:**

1. Read `~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json` → find the `synaptory@h3tech-ai` entry → extract `version` (this is your local version).
2. WebFetch `https://synaptory.h3t.co/cli/latest.json` → extract `version` (this is the remote version).
3. **If WebFetch fails** (offline, timeout, non-200) → silently continue. Never block the pipeline over an update check.
4. **If remote ≤ local** → continue silently (user sees nothing).
5. **If remote > local** → prompt:

```python
AskQuestion(questions=[{
  "question": "synaptory v{remote} is available (you have v{local})",
  "header": "Update Available",
  "options": [
    {"label": "Update to v{remote} (Recommended)", "description": "Run /plugin marketplace update and restart"},
    {"label": "Skip — continue with v{local}", "description": "Use current version"}
  ],
  "multiSelect": false
}])
```

6. **If skip** → continue pipeline with current version.
7. **If update** → do **not** shell out to `git clone` or hand-edit `installed_plugins.json`. Claude Code owns the plugin cache. Print:

   ```
   To update, run this in Claude Code:

       /plugin marketplace update synaptory@h3tech-ai

   Then re-invoke /synaptory to pick up v{remote}.
   ```

   - **STOP** — do not continue pipeline. The current session has the old SKILL.md loaded; the user must run the slash command and re-invoke.

**If any update step fails**, print a one-line warning and continue with the current version. Never let the updater break the pipeline.
